question: Bicameralism was borrowed into the Constitution of India from which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The UK.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The important provisions borrowed from Britain are:

 
 
• Parliamentary form of government
 
• Rule of Law.
 
• Single Citizenship.
 
• Office of Comptroller and Auditor General of India.
 
• **Bicameralism.**
 
• Writs.
